question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping maintains firm control over the Chinese Communist Party and People's Liberation Army through ongoing purges and rectification campaigns, including 2026 expulsions from the NPC and senior military ranks that have reinforced loyalty rather than signaled weakness. Traders assign a 95.5% implied probability to him remaining in power through 2026 because no term limits constrain his tenure, the next major leadership transition aligns with the 2027 Party Congress, and public activities show continued policy engagement on initiatives like Healthy China. Realistic shifts could stem from an unforeseen health event, abrupt elite realignment ahead of the congress, or a severe economic or external crisis that erodes his position, though current evidence points to sustained dominance.
